items.html:
(to the question) The lower lights enter first
First the most refined vessels are clarified, and afterward the coarse vessels are clarified, as is known. And since the upper one bestows only upon the coarser thing — that is, the coarser the screen is, the higher the level it brings out — it turns out that at first, when only the phase of the coarseness of the root had been clarified, only the level of Malchut came out there, which is the level of NHY, called pregnancy. And afterward, at the time of birth, when the phase of coarseness of BYA was revealed, it brought out the level of Ruach, called nursing, and so forth, as is known. Hence the lower lights come out first, and afterward the upper lights. (Page 197, Item 193).
